text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Slept like a log...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Gah, it's already this late!?
It's past noon!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's been ages since I slept in like this.
Usually—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOOOD
MAAARVELOOOUUUS!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, where did Marvelous go?
There's no sign of her coming back, either—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well... she's vanished out of the blue from time to time before, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is all this!?
There's a ridiculous amount of juice here...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nature! I bought a drink thinking I'd give it to you, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I bought one bottle, and winning tickets just kept popping out!
The Marvelous Rush won't stop~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I came all the way out here to check, but...
Guess lightning doesn't strike twice.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Now that I think about it, there was that other time too—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!? A cryptid! It's a cryptid UMA!
Look! In the bushes right next to you, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No way... really...!?

text_block_list.name: Nature & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: ...That's just a raccoon dog!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not here either, huh.
...Man, every single day with Marvelous is completely out of the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Nature!
I found a split end that splits into eight pieces!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature, Nature! A mysterious voice is coming
from a TV channel that's not even supposed to work!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... you're always
causing the weirdest things to happen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's just Marvelous for ya.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Looks like I couldn't find her...
Guess I'll go ahead and make a late lunch.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?! Marvelous?!
You were here the whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nature!
Just hold on, the food will be ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Food?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When you're too tired to get up, you need a Marvelous injection☆
So I was making a marvelous morning meal
just for you, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's what this was.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now then☆ Time for the secret ingredient,
Marvelous Spice...★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey, what is that?!
Wait wait, let me take over...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...And while we're at it, let's make
some of those snacks you like too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marve-marve-marve-Marvelous☆
Ma-ma-ma-Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for startling you.
Jeez, this girl is always...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, being with Nature has me at full Marvelous power☆
Let's go search for brand-new Marvelous things today!
choice_data_list: You two sure get along well.
You two sure get along well.
Looks like you'll never run out of Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, yeah. She's always
dragging me along for the ride, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...at the end of the day, she gives me plenty of energy, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Though sometimes it feels
a bit like an oversupply.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah?! Fluffy UMA spotted—!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A-Again?! Hold on, wait up!
